name: Manual posting assistant — /post-now command
goal: Add /post-now Telegram command (owner-only). Shows top 3 unposted videos that have a captioned .mp4 file on disk. For each: full file path, speaker/topic (if stored in ledger), hashtags (from viral-topics.json or defaults), next optimal posting slot (07/12/18/21), /record shortcut. Bridges gap: operator has 114 videos ready on disk but no Telegram-native way to find file paths or get formatted TikTok metadata.
rationale: 0/30 posts, 22 days to Apr 7 gate. The operator needs to start posting manually TODAY. /queue shows video_ids but not file paths or copy-paste metadata. /post-now gives everything needed: file path on disk + title suggestion + hashtags + time slot + /record command in one Telegram message.
swarm: NOT USED — 2 file edits + 1 validation script. Direct write.

tasks.title: commands.ts — handlePostNow() + handleHelp() update
tasks.description: handlePostNow(chatId, ownerChatId): owner gate. Loads ledger + manual-posts (reuse existing pattern). Parses run_id to epoch (scs001-2026-03-16T16-39-58-797Z → 1773679198797) to build run dir path. For each unposted entry, checks existsSync for workspace/scs001/run-{epoch}/caption/{video_id}-captioned.mp4. Takes top 3 with valid files. For each shows: video_id, file path (~/ relative), speaker (if in ledger), topic (trimmed to 60 chars, if in ledger), hashtags (load viral-topics.json topics array → prefix with #, add #fyp #viral #learnontiktok), next slot (compute from current hour: 07/12/18/21, if past 21:00 → tomorrow 07:00), /record shortcut. handleHelp: add '/post-now — Find videos ready to post with file path + metadata (owner)' line.
